description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to safe binary profiles, including profile fixtures, profile compilation, normalization, and documentation rendering for command-line flags.

methods.name: collectKnownLongFlags
methods.description: Collects all long flags starting with '--' from allowed and denied flags.

methods.name: buildLongFlagPrefixMap
methods.description: Builds a prefix map for known long flags to facilitate abbreviation resolution.

methods.name: compileSafeBinProfile
methods.description: Compiles a SafeBinProfile from a fixture, computing flags and prefix map.

methods.name: compileSafeBinProfiles
methods.description: Creates multiple SafeBinProfiles from a record of fixtures.

methods.name: normalizeSafeBinProfileName
methods.description: Normalizes profile names by trimming and lowercasing.

methods.name: normalizeFixtureLimit
methods.description: Normalizes fixture limit values to non-negative integers.

methods.name: normalizeFixtureFlags
methods.description: Normalizes an array of flags, trimming, deduplicating, and sorting.

methods.name: normalizeSafeBinProfileFixtures
methods.description: Normalizes a set of fixtures, filtering invalid names.
